scope: Every tracked native source/header is accounted for. Retained platform adapters, binding code and independent C test oracles are not claimed as Zig ports.

Original tiny-regex implementation and bindings retained; dialect ported and differentially tested
Original scanner and binding retained; existing faithful Zig and new dirty-row candidate
Nested Adder traversal ported with bounded depth, cycle rejection and ordered arithmetic
Star motion ported and measured; original per-star Ruby object/render adapter retained, batched Ruby rendering integration pending
Retained Objective-C Foundation/main-thread dispatch boundary; no portable compute kernel or platform validation claimed
Greeting formatting ported; original Foundation classes and SDK registration retained, real macOS engine validation pending
Retained Steamworks C++ ABI and Ruby registration; initialization/error handling and SDK execution are not migrated in this suite
Retained JNI platform boundary; JNI lifetime/exception cleanup and Android execution remain pending
Worker ownership and atomic lifecycle ported; real pthread tests, original SDL/Ruby registration retained
Connection/statement ownership ported and measured against real SQLite; original Ruby query_json adapter retained
Retained SDK adapter, C ABI oracles and test-only host support; preserves the independent proof from PR #1
Retained Rust FFI bindings, rure public header and C tests/examples; tiny-regex is not a replacement for the Rust regex API
